person.name: Vincenzo Sammartino
person.summary: PhD candidate in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Pisa (Italian National PhD Programme in AI, doctoral position November 2024 – October 2027) and former Visiting PhD Student (VSRP Intern) at KAUST, January–June 2026. Works on Security Twins and Digital Twin architectures for cybersecurity, cyber-physical systems resilience, quantum machine learning and post-quantum security, 6G far-edge digital twins, UAV swarm security with TinyML and Edge AI, the security of LLM-driven multi-agent systems, and NLP.

researchThemes.name: Security Twin
researchThemes.description: Non-intrusive digital twin architectures for real-time cyber threat simulation, what-if analysis, attack-path reasoning and proactive defence in cyber-physical systems (NotLine, HAVE, D3F).

researchThemes.name: Quantum ML & post-quantum security
researchThemes.description: Hybrid quantum graph neural networks, quantum feature encoding, quantum-classical physical-layer authentication (QUASAR) and CSIDH-based post-quantum cryptography for industrial IoT.

researchThemes.name: 6G & far-edge digital twins
researchThemes.description: Semantic-aware digital twin synchronisation and quantum-native far-edge architectures with asynchronous federated learning.

researchThemes.name: UAV swarm security
researchThemes.description: Byzantine-resilient anomaly detection with TinyML and Edge AI for decentralised drone swarms (ResilientGuard, KAUST), and acoustic counter-UAV perimeter intrusion detection with drone-mounted microphones.

researchThemes.name: LLM & AI-agent security
researchThemes.description: Security threats and defences in LLM-driven agentic and multi-agent systems — prompt injection, tool misuse, inter-agent trust, privilege escalation — surveyed in Knowledge-Based Systems (Elsevier, 2026), and the use of LLMs plus synthetic data for next-generation cyber defence.

researchThemes.name: Synthetic data for cybersecurity
researchThemes.description: Synthetic dataset generation for robust intrusion detection and autonomous defence.

researchThemes.name: Least privilege in databases
researchThemes.description: Schema-level decomposition enforcing fine-grained access control in healthcare and enterprise systems.

researchThemes.name: Natural language processing
researchThemes.description: Hate speech and stereotype detection, sentiment polarity classification and figurative language in Italian and multi-domain corpora.
